exposure: combined intracevical Foley catheter and low dose prostaglandin E2 gel
cohort: 54 women with one previous lower segment cesarean section and an unfavorable Bishop score at term.
finding: Combined induction of labor with low dose prostaglandin E2 gel and intracevical Foley catheter is safe and effective in women with a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: 83.33% of participants had a vaginal delivery and 16.67% had an emergency cesarean section.
